headline: Embraer approves full incorporation of inactive subsidiary GPX to streamline structure
summary: Embraer's shareholders approved the full incorporation of its wholly owned subsidiary GPX Ltda., which has been inactive since 2019, to simplify its corporate structure and reduce administrative costs.
why: Corporate reorganizations by major aerospace manufacturers like Embraer aim to optimize operational efficiency and lower overhead expenses.

impacts.name: Embraer
impacts.why: Subsidiary absorption streamlines administrative costs without altering core business operations.
